name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=chapter, descriptor=06_end). The '06' is the chapter ID (valid 1-30 domain ID, must be preserved) and '_end' is the end-handler role, not a Ghidra address remnant. Name accurately reflects the function (chapter 6 end handler).
purpose: Chapter 6 'Pulitz Harbor' (普里茲港) end handler: recruits archer 貝克威, runs the post-battle cutscene, then advances to the next chapter.
logic_summary: Recruits char id 0xD (#13, 弓兵貝克威) via fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth; refreshes the portrait cache for race 3 (fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(3)); pans the camera/window to (5,0xE) (fd2_pan_cursor_and_window); fires cutscene event 0x1B (fd2_cutscene_event_trigger); shows chapter-end dialog page 6 (fd2_display_dialog_scene over data_fd2_current_chapter_text); persists the party runtime-char state (fd2_save_runtime_char_to_template); increments data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id. Dispatched via the chapter-end pointer table @ 0x51DE9 (xref from 0x51DFD); no direct callers. In the binary it ends with JMP 0x231DF (tail-jump into the shared tail of fd2_chapter_04_end: PUSH text; dialog; cleanup; save; INC chapter id; RET); emitted in src as a self-contained function (Layer 2 functional equivalence).

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects: recruits a char, plays cutscene, saves party state, advances current chapter id.

reads_globals: data_fd2_current_chapter_text (passed as the text base to fd2_display_dialog_scene)
comment_original_issue: Source comment said the function 'falls through into the shared tail of fd2_chapter_04_end @ 0x231DF', but the disassembly shows it ends with an explicit JMP 0x231DF (a tail-jump, not a fall-through). This matched neither chapter_04's own plate (which describes the sharing as 'JMP into the shared tail rather than calling') nor the consistent 'tail-jump' wording used by sibling handlers (ch08/09/11/13/15/19). Also one em-dash (U+2014) was present where ASCII '--' is required.
notes: Recruit identity verified: chapter_06 walkthrough states '加入：弓兵貝克威'; fd2-knowledge char list confirms 貝克威 is a 狙擊手 (archer) class. All five callee names match live Ghidra (fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth @ 0x112a5, fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp @ 0x10b4e, fd2_pan_cursor_and_window @ 0x135dd, fd2_cutscene_event_trigger @ 0x1366a, __CHK stack-probe @ 0x36cd7). Tail-jump target 0x231df is inside fd2_chapter_04_end (body 0x231bc-0x231f8). Ghidra plate facts are all consistent with src (same recruit char, callees, dialog page, paired init/post-action) so plate left unchanged; only its older 'Body (82B)' listing format differs cosmetically, which is not a contradiction warranting churn. No logic touched.
